articleTitle: High Gain Microstrip-Fed Patch Antenna using Periodic Dielectric Substrate
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: A microstrip line fed patch antenna using dielectric sheets is proposed for gain enhancement. The proposed antenna consists of 20 periodic dielectric sheets placed perpendicularly above the insert fed patch antenna. By varying the distance between the patch antenna and periodic dielectric sheets and also the periodicity between the sheets, the peak gain of the designed patch-dielectric structure is improved from 5.37 dBi to 10 dBi. At S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> = -10 dB, the simulated impedance bandwidth of the antenna is 3.91% (2.404 - 2.5) GHz. At the operating bandwidth, the gain varies from 9.6 dBi to 10 dBi.

articleTitle: A Survey on Speckle Removal for Optical Coherence Tomography Images
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) has shown a great potential in providing clarity in scanned images. Speckle noise is one major factor present in the OCT images. It reduces interpretation and diagnosis and reduces both contrast and signal to noise ratio (SNR). The OCT images contains speckle noise which makes it difficult to interpret. To reduce this problem, specialized noise reduction techniques are used to eliminate the noise while conserving image details. This paper presents a comparative analysis based on the performance metrics used in the existing techniques. The objective of this article to remove speckle noise from OCT images without distortion in edges and to increase signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: QoS and Sum Rate Maximization in Heterogeneous Massive MIMO Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Fifth generation wireless communication aims at providing high data rate for long range signal transmission consuming high power in the network. The increase of power must be proficient considering the limitation of the interference without demolishing the quality of service in the network. This work can be analyzed by densifying the network using Massive MIMO with small cell access where maximum sum rate can be achieved. The work in this paper aims at providing better QoS by minimizing the total power and maximizing the sum rate in the heterogeneous network deployed with maximal ratio transmission beamforming technique. The simulation results of maximal ratio transmission prove that better sum rate can be achieved at the penalty of power consumption and it is compared with that of existing regularized zero forcing.

articleTitle: Intelligent Safety Information Dissemination Scheme for V2V Communication in VANETs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Vehicular communication is an advent technology that has progressively supporting safe transportation, traffic related information and other intelligent transportation system related applications. In VANET architecture vehicles on the road lane communicates each other with the short range communication standard wireless technologies. Advances of wireless networks make access to the internet from VANETs is possible. Some of the specic characteristics of VANETs are varying mobility, transient connectivity, dynamic topology etc.. The different architectural VANET scenarios are Vehicle to Vehicle (V-V), vehicle to road-side (V-I) and vehicle to fixed connected infrastructure to provide the safety and timely delivery of captured information. In this paper, we have proposed multi agent based safety information dissemination scheme for vehicle to vehicle(V-V) communication. In the proposed dissemination scheme, we have used selection of far end node in exterior range for information delivery with reduced number of transmissions. The main contribution of our proposed research work is the design and development of critical information delivery with minimum end to end delay.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control and Monitoring of Electrical Outlets and Appliances using IoT
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The Project - Intelligent Control and Monitoring of Electrical Outlets and Appliances using IoT aims to develop a Smart control module that can be used to schedule the operation of electrical appliances as well as control and monitor power usage at the outlet location. The hardware developed is designed to be a replacement for the traditional electrical switch boards. An application which remains in sync with the designed hardware. The hardware is also fully capable of offline operation and the system will start to sync with the developed iOS Application when an active internet connection is available via a WiFi access point.

articleTitle: Recurrence and Non-Recurrence Prediction of Uterus Cancer Using Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Women now a days at their teen age they do endure the pain of taking treatment for the cancer in which they are equal to the pain of the death in order to avoid the fear of being treated for the cancer disease with the help of the existing data mining algorithm we can predict the occurrence and non-occurrence duration of the patient by envisaging the uterus cancer in the women we can avoid the number of death rate and the patients who have been treated for the cancer. However many people they even do not have the money to afford for their treatment so in order to help the poor and the wealthy people this paper aims to predict the occurrence and non-occurrence duration of the patient with the help of the following algorithm we can predict them they are of hidden markov model, neural network, linear filtering with the support of the big data. The prediction of the uterus cancer recurrence period is done by analyzing the image format health records of the patient.

articleTitle: An Hybrid Wavelet Based SFTA Technique For Content Based MRI Brain Image Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This research work introduces the new feature extraction technique to retrieve identical diseased MRI brain images from the collection of images available in the hospital database. Single attribute of any image is not enough to accurately retrieve the similar case images from the database containing same disease image differ by severity. With intension of giving solution to above problem the proposed CBMIR module uses the hybrid features i.e., WSFTA (Segmentation based Fractal Texture Analysis and wavelet coded image features). The database consisting of 150 brain MR images with three classes were utilized to calculate the efficiency of the suggested module. Experimental result demonstrates the excellence of the system with improved accuracy and shows the ability to work successfully in medical application.

articleTitle: An Introspective Study on Dynamic Role-Centric RBAC Models
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: With the advent of internet and its related technologies, the organizations are more concerned in providing security to their resources. Access control models helps in providing the access limits to the users when the resources are being accessed by them and Role based access control (RBAC) model is one such access control mechanism in which the users access the resources based on the roles they acquire in the system. In the dynamic environment, the roles that an user acquires in the system is completely depending on the context in which the user sends an access request. This paper explores the concepts of RBAC models and their extensions. The main objective of this paper is to analyse the access control models by identifying their applications and limitations in the real world applications.

articleTitle: Improvisation on NiO based Thin Film Solar Cell Conversion Efficiency by the Addition of Dopants
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: There is a growing need for the development of thin film flexible solar cells with improved efficiency based on the market demand. This review article helps to compare nickel oxide based thin films with other metal oxides which are used to make thin film solar cells. CdS/CdTe, CIGS and GaAs based thin film solar cells also discussed and compared their efficiencies with metal oxide based solar cells. Various processing methods used for the preparation of thin films are discussed in the literature review part and the suitable method for making thin films are proposed. The work carried out so far with the addition of dopants such as Sr, Cu, Ag, Y, Au and Li concentration in nickel oxide layer was discussed. Thin film solar cell efficiencies with and without dopants in NiO layer are compared in a detailed manner in this article. The efficiencies of doped and undoped NiO based thin film solar cells with single crystal silicon solar cells are also compared.

articleTitle: Biomechanical Sports Analysis Using Inertial Measurement Unit
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The proposed idea is to develop a system that will help a sportsperson to analyze their technique of playing shots in sports. The same system can be extended for the analysis of actions in sports like Tennis, Badminton, and Swimming, analysis of posture in Yoga and body stabilization. Human performances dealt with the law of mechanics and physics that provides the performance knowledge for athletics events through modeling, simulation and measurement. When related to sports, biomechanics has contributed to describe, explain, and predict the mechanical features of human exercises, sports and plays. Hawk eye is an instrument which is used in cricket, tennis, soccer and other sports to track the movement of the player while playing. This system uses a camera; it takes the 600b frames per second on the goal line. The information is analysed using computer and it is sent to the headset of the judges. As accelerometers weigh less and small, they be placed on any part or segment of the body without hindering performance. They are also very cheap compared to the other technologies.

articleTitle: Design of a Compact MIMO Antenna for LTE Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The long Term Evolution (LTE) is the current-generation mobile communication standard providing high data rate. As a key component of the LTE wireless system, the multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) antenna has attracted significant research power in the recent years for its well-known advantages of increasing transmission capacity and reducing multipath fading. A MIMO antenna consists of at least two radiating elements placed at certain distance to have high isolation between them, but the available space is very limited in the modern portable wireless front-ends. Various techniques have been proposed to improve isolation in MIMO antenna for LTE application. Mutual coupling between the perpendicularly placed antennas can be reduced by using narrow stubs in the ground plane and slots in the radiating elements. The designed antenna has simple structure and compact size of 50 X 20 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. High isolation between the MIMO elements is achieved by introducing a dual linear stub in the ground plane of the MIMO antenna which has mutual coupling less than -20 dB. The designed antenna is analysed using full-wave electromagnetic software HFSS.

articleTitle: Cluster Head Selection using Distance and Residual Energy for VANET
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The sensor hubs are thickly conveyed in a situation to screen, distinguish and to dissect the physical marvel. Expending significant measure of vitality while transmitting the data is unreasonable and at times difficult to supplant the battery to keep up longer system lifetime. The confinement on the lifetime of the battery power and vitality protection is a testing issue. Drain is the most celebrated various leveled directing convention, where the Cluster Head is choice in pivot. Utilizing Ant Colony optimization calculation the briefest way to the base station is found and hub chose for the bunch head. In this methodology, we consider both the separation between the hub and the base station and the vitality of the hub to choose the bunch head and increment the lifetime of the system.

articleTitle: Feature Based Classification of Retinal Blood Vessels Using Multifractal Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In this work, multifractal method is used to segment and analyze human retinal fundus images. Both in normal and abnormal cases, the retinal images acquired under standard protocols undergoes segmentation process for extraction of retinal vasculature. From the segmented vessels, different performance measures are obtained by comparing the segmented image with ground truth images. Using Support Vector Machines (SVM), these significant performance measures along with the derived parameter of Vessel to Vessel Free (VVF) area ratio are further subjected to classification. By using this method normal and abnormal images can be differentiated. When compared to other kernels SVM classifier with order 3 polynomial kernel gives better performance. The proposed study seems to be useful in assisting clinical interventions related to retinal disorders.

articleTitle: Binary Interactive Search Based Facelift Feature Selection Method for Household Classification Data on Smart Electricity Meter Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Smart meter data is one among a set of massive data where there are infinite number of features are still inside it which in need of an effective mining approach for extracting from it. However, addressing every features for all problems may not be an effective way for any kind of problem addressing methodology. Hence, based on the need the features to be filtered out to improve the accuracy of the results. In this paper, an effective BIS Algorithm (BISA) has been proposed to address the problem of feature selection for classification of household data. Based on the results, it is evident that the proposed algorithm works efficiently when compared with the other existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Recommending Web Service by Predicting Quality of Service using Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Owing to rapid growth of web services in service-based systems, the user should be provided with efficient service quality evaluation methods. Service quality is one of the most important features of software quality to predict the overall performance that helps to decide which web service should be manipulated. Both reliable and unreliable users are contributed by the service quality values leads to inaccuracy of the forecasting outcomes. To overcome this problem, we proposed the approach to detect the forecasting results accurately in unknown web service quality values using Matrix Factorization by Reputation with Hidden Markov Model (HMM). The experimental outcome shows that our proposed approach has improved accuracy to predict the reliable and unreliable users with other existing approaches.

articleTitle: Simulation of Piezoelectric Composite MEMS Ultrasonic Transducer for Level Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Ultrasonic transducers are being used in systems where targets are evaluated by interpretation of the reflected signals. This project aims at providing a prototype of Piezoelectric composite Ultrasonic transducer. This type of transducer is particularly applied in monitoring systems specifically for level monitoring. Since the ultrasonic transducers are designed at micro scale, it can be used to create a network with other sensors and actuators for establishing a system for monitoring and controlling parameters in aerospace applications. A 3D modelling of the structure is obtained; finally frequency analysis of the device is performed. Sensitivity of the structure when subjected to three different proof mass materials are presented. This is done by plotting the Susceptance of the device.

articleTitle: Analysis of Drawbacks in 802.X and Significant Methodologies on Data Recovery
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Bluetooth, a short range communication standard, helps in sharing information between paired devices with high security, using Frequency Hopping Spread Spectrum (FHSS) technique. When a file is being transmitted, the link between the devices undergo any distraction, and if the link is broken, even after transmitting 70% more amount of data, there will 0% in the receiver device, or it cannot be opened as its not completely received. The proposed idea is to develop an effective communication that will help an individual to retrieve the data, first, by moving the receiving content to permanent memory soon after every N bits received in buffer. Secondly by fixing a timeslot after which the content will be moved to permanent memory. With the amount of information received, using bilinear interpolation technique, the left out data (if it is below 30%) is predicted to complete the process.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Different Measures to Identify Driver States
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Road accidents are major issue that creates problem in the society. To overcome the issue, driver behavior and the driving environment has to be monitored regularly and alert the driver before any accident may occur. This could be possible only on analyzing four measures: subjective, behavioral, physiological and vehicle-based. These combined hybrid measures can provide better accuracy on determining various states of driver like normal, drowsy, cognitive and visual inattention. In hybrid measures, physiological measure plays a major role by increasing the accuracy, specificity, sensitivity of the driver state detection. Physiological measures are the signals recorded from various parts of the human body using biosensors to check the internal condition of the driver while driving. These signals can be Electroencephalogram (EEG), Electrocardiogram (ECG), Electro-oculogram (EOG) and Electromyogram (EMG). EEG signals are the brain activity data which corresponds to EEG wave band determines the physical state of the driver. Most researchers have worked on EEG for better accuracy in driver state detection. This paper is one such review on various measures in determining driver states while driving.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Storage Warehouses in a Food Grain Supply Chain using Data Envelopment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Food Grain Procurement organization takes the responsibility of storing food grains in the country for Public Distribution System and other welfare programmes. Operating warehouses is a challenging task due to the various reasons such as seasonality in the procurement of grains, deviation from the movement plan, delays in the lifting operation of food grains from warehouses and in-flexible nature of work-force. Through this study, a Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) model is developed to calculate the relative efficiency of warehouses owned by an Indian Food grain procurement organisation. The model is used to establish ranking among warehouses.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Power Efficient Encoder for Transition Reduction in Off-Chip Buses Using Adaptive Bus Encoding Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper deals with the design and implementation of power efficient encoder for transition reduction in off chip buses using ABE (Adaptive Bus Encoding) technique. In both the embedded and high performance systems, the effect of power consumption is becoming highly prominent, whereas the off-chip data buses remains to be a considerable power consumer. In most cases, the input data streams are not known because of the fact that the data streams are more random and less sequential. With subject to this, the adaptive bus encoding (ABE) mechanism is introduced which is executed without the preliminary knowledge about the required input streams. The proposed methodology of this paper make use of the spatial redundancy for the prevention of data loss while recovering them. This ABE framework reduces the transitions in highly capacitive off-chip buses and also this technique is associated with the power dissipation in the off chip buses for the significance of power efficiency and high speed communication. Thus, it minimises the extra dynamic power consumption due to the encoding circuitry mechanism.

articleTitle: Efficient Query Processing With Logical Indexing For Spatial and Temporal Data in Geospatial Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Presently a days remarkable improvement of the web innovation and sensor innovation, the worldwide spatial information, alongside its huge volume and multi-scale highlights, clarifies higher prerequisites for information association. The spatial network has been generally utilized in many guide list. In any case, when spatial articles have multi-scale, the spatial matrix list with proportionate networks has been critized for its low-efficiencies. To tackle this issue, here proposed an intelligent list just as upset record dependent on GeoSOT subdivision lattices. By methods for this list, we can accomplish question task productively paying little heed to the sizes of spatial articles.

articleTitle: Design & Isolation Reduction of Circle Inserted MIMO Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In modern telecommunications system MIMO antenna plays an important role having the capability to radiate wave is extra than one radiation pattern & polarization is also another critical factor. This article describes the design & reduction of isolation between the two symmetrical patches. The separation between the two patches must be maintained to reduce the isolation is 0.02 λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>. The proposed system having a compact size of 38 mm × 25 mm with a FR-4 substrate and loss tangent of 0.02 is considered. The MIMO system is resonate at a frequency of 3.98 GHz obtained the reflection coefficient (S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>) of -39.71 dB & greatly reducing the isolation (S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>) of -50 dB. At the resonant band of frequency the impedance bandwidth of the systems is around 1.76 GHz. The proposed design maintained the VSWR ≤ 2 and ECC <; 0.04 is maintained at the resonant band of frequency. The different time domain analysis parameters like group delay, diversity gain, real/ imaginary impedances and peak gain is also measured here. The group delay and diversity gain at the resonant frequency of proposed MIMO structure is observed -2.48 ± 1nsec & 9.999 dBi.

articleTitle: Improvement of Energy Storage in Lithium Polymer Battery With NANO Composite Material (ZrO2)
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper deals with the application of polymer and nano composite material in enhancing the energy storage capacity of the lithium polymer battery. Here in this work a series of solid polymer electrolyte thin films are developed through solution-cast technique. PMMA (poly (methyl methacrylate) is used as the host polymer, PC (propylene carbonate) mixture is applied as a plasticiser, LiPF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> (lithium hexaflurophosphate) is used as a carrier source and the dispersion of ZrO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> (Zirconium Oxide) as ceramic fillers.Test samples are prepared with different weight ratios of their individual compositions. The samples were tested and the best sample results which increases the storage capacity is found out.

Author Keywords: nano filler ZrO2 and composite material

articleTitle: Examination of 2D Cardiac MRI using Softcomputing Assisted Scheme
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This work presents an image inspection procedure to extract and evaluate the heart section from a two-dimensional (2D) Magnetic-Resonance-Image (MRI) collected from HVSMR2016 database. This study implements Social-Group-Optimization (SGO) and Tsallis Entropy (TE) assisted thresholding to enhance the test picture and Active-Contour-Segmentation (ACS) to extract Region-Of-Interest (ROI) from enhanced cardiac MRI. The main merit of the proposed technique is, the MRI is available in the gray scale form, and hence the computation cost is less when it is employed with a suitable heuristic technique. The cardiac MRI considered from the - database consist a three-dimension (3D) picture along with a 3D ground-truth (GT). In this work, the 2D slices are initially extracted from the test image and the GT and the extracted 2D slices are examined with the proposed scheme. After extracting the ROI, the essential similarity-measure (SM) are then calculated with a study between the ROI and GT. The outcome of this technique confirms that, proposed technique helps to achieve an average result > 90%. In future, it can be considered to examine the other MRIs existing in the literature.

articleTitle: Tinge within the Fringe
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Augmented Reality (AR) is a technology that provides the composite view of an environment, thus presenting quite amazing experience for the user who utilizes the applications that apply it. Coloring is always fun and if Augmented Reality is embedded with coloring, then it is definitely an amusement. Coloring owns an important part in autistic children as they detect colors with higher intensity and have strong ability to associate colors with entities. Hence, we will create a model that will deploy Augmented Reality, providing a learning experience along with coloring to engage the autistic children at home.

articleTitle: PSO Based Clustering Approach for Mobile Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In several domains like disaster hit areas, agriculture, military, health care, defense, etc., Mobile Wireless Sensor Networks (MWSNs) have been employed. When the sensor nodes are resource limited, the main attribute which act as a key role in modeling MWSNs protocol are its computational feasibility and energy efficiency. The Sensor nodes distance variation from inter node distances and base station (BS) initially leads to unequivalent energy utilization between the sensor nodes. The utilization of energy differs with period and cause system performance deprivation. LEACH is the primarily clustered depended routing protocol that gives fine solutions, endures from the disadvantages in order to the cluster head (CH) selection that are randomized. With the conventional clustering algorithm, considering severe energy rebalancing, a Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) based clustering method that examines the fitness function through assuming the two main attributes (distance and energy) is projected in this paper. PSO is a search depended method which is probabilistic method depends on the natural selection principle and evolution. Experimental outcomes verifies that the projected protocol performs well when compared LEACH protocol with better network lifetime.

articleTitle: An Effective Charge Plasma based Semi-Superjunction MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper presents a distinct design of a semi-superjunction (Semi-SJ) MOSFET that enhances the performance of the device with reduced fabrication complexity. Charge plasma concept is employed in a Semi-SJ MOSFET structure. Metals with appropriate work-function are used to form the source and drain contacts. The proposed Semi-SJ device is simulated and the results are compared with the conventional Semi-SJ MOSFET. The proposed device exhibits upto 14% improvement in the current driving capability and the area specific ON-resistance (R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on</sub>.A) of the device is reduced by 13%, maintaining the same value of breakdown voltage(BV). Consequently, the trade-off between the R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on</sub>.A and breakdown voltage is optimized.

articleTitle: Z-Source Multilevel Inverter based AFLC PV System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper expansion a Multilevel Inverter assembled on Adaptive fuzzy logic controlled Photo voltaic scheme. The Symmetrical Phase Shift Modulation (PSM) technique is used and the active device present in the Multilevel Inverter produces a power loss with shoot-through problem. The proposed system consists of PV system, Z-source, Multilevel Inverter, AFLC controller. Z-source is second-hand to protect the Multilevel Inverter from the shoot-through problem and to diminish the switching loss before switching strain of the scheme. A switched-capacitor based cascaded multilevel inverter with Symmetrical Phase Shift Modulation technique is used. The controller is used to evaluate the performance of the proposed system and the output of controllers is compared. The model study of the proposed converter is supported by using MATLAB/Simulink with proposed nine level inverter.

articleTitle: “Minimizing Penalty in Industrial Power Consumption by Using APFC unit”: A Review
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The proposed device automatically corrects the power factor without any human presence. It consists of a microcontroller which detects the power factor value, if the power factor goes below 0.9(lagging) during peak hours it automatically connects capacitor banks to improve it. Now a days, one APFC panel cannot be used for different application. To make it universal we provide four keys UP, DOWN, ENTER, MENU. These keys are used to enter the capacitor values and to vary the CT ratio. As the capacitor values and current magnitude varies according to the application. The main aim of the proposed model is to maintain the power factor nearer to 0.9 which helps to increase the efficiency of the system.

articleTitle: Development of a Mechanism to Dock a Robotic Self-Transfer Device to a Wheelchair
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: A Robotic self-Transfer device was developed to transfer individuals with lower limb disabilities from a wheelchair to any other surface and vice versa on his/her own without a caregiver's support. The device is aimed at providing independence and privacy to people with disabilities in performing day-to-day activities. This device was designed in such a way that it can be attached or detached, i.e. docked or undocked, to/from the wheelchair whenever necessary. In the existing design, the docking and undocking of the self-transfer device to the wheelchair is found to have some limitations in certain scenarios. Hence, this paper discusses development of a new mechanism to enable easy attachment and detachment of the self-transfer device to/from a wheelchair. Initially a conceptual design of the docking mechanism was formulated, later the design was 3D printed, further it was automated and subsequently it was implemented successfully in a Proof of Concept (PoC) test set up.

articleTitle: Elegant Way of Designing Printed Circuit Board via Multilayer Technique Using Ultiboard 12.0
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: PCB design plays a vital role in the evolution of modern technology. Dual side PCB has two conductive layers, multi-side PCB should have at least three conductive layers which are buried in the centre of the material. Layers of copper foil, prepreg and core material sandwich together under high temperature and pressure to produce multi-layer. Multilayer board can pack the same amount of power into a PCB that's half the size of the original or traditional double-sided PCB. The demonstration will be done by using NI Ultiboard 12.0. In this project, the datum we get from our PCB, it is an obvious way to reduce the cost of PCB and to simplify the design of PCB. It can be done by reducing the number of vias and components.

articleTitle: Hybrid Model for Web Application Vulnerability Assessment Using Decision Tree and Bayesian Belief Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In the existing situation, most of the business process are running through web applications. This helps the enterprises to grow their business efficiently which creates a good consumer relationship. But the main problem is that they failed to provide a vulnerable free environment. To overcome this issue in web applications, vulnerability assessment should be made periodically. They are many vulnerability assessment methodologies which occur earlier are not much proactive. So, machine learning is needed to provide a combined solution to determine vulnerability occurrence and percentage of vulnerability occurred in logical web pages. We use Decision Tree and Bayesian Belief Network (BBN) as a collective solution to find either vulnerability occur in web applications and the vulnerability occurred percentage on different logical web pages.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis and Comparison of Various Optical Sources With Optical Soliton
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper presents the performance analysis of the optical system by comparing the ordinary pulse with the different optical source pulses. Some of the optical sources are CW laser, Super-Gaussian, Raised Cosine and Soliton pulse. Soliton pulse is preferred for long distance communication, raised cosine is helpful in reducing inter-symbol interference, super-Gaussian helps in maintaining the same pulse shape throughout the system, CW laser is to have more power during transmission. The proposed paper is to analyse the dispersion of the signal in fibre during the long haul communication gets diminished. The performance analysis is made for the data rate of lOGbps, by measuring the BER, eye diagram. The designed system is verified for a varied length of the fibre such as 50km, 100km. the obtained Q-factor is high for the soliton pulse.

articleTitle: Satellite Image Classification Using Self Organizing Map And Ensemble Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Satellite picture request process incorporates gathering the image pixel regards into significant classes. A few satellite picture characterized strategies and systems are accessible. In existing k-medoid clustering technique is used for clustering the satellite data, with this method not able to cluster accurately all the classes. In our proposed method self-organizing map as a clustering technique is used. Self-organizing maps clustering the data based on similarity, topologies, with a preferences of appointing the same value to each classes. Self-organizing map clustering are used to reduces a dimensionality of data and to cluster the data. These are motivated by the tactile and engine mappings in the vertebrate cerebrum, which additionally appears to consequently organizing out data topologically. Our propose technique is Ensemble clustering with subspace discriminant algorithm for classification of satellite data into water, Agriculture, Barren land, Green Land. The proposed method of self-organising map clustering and ensemble classifier with subspace discriminant is given best result compared to existing ones.

articleTitle: Prediction of Chronic Disease by Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In the field of biomedical and healthcare communities the accurate prediction plays the major role to find out the risk of the disease in the patient [15]. The prediction gives the benefits of early disease detection. However the analysis accuracy as the relationship with the condition of the medical data, thus the poor condition of the medical data [4] leads to less accuracy of prediction. Here we use a certain machine learning algorithm to state the rate of disease. Prediction process is done using the dataset provided online from certain hospitals, the entire dataset will be preprocessed and the missing values will be reconstructed. Compared to several types of prediction algorithms, the RNN algorithm [21]gives the highest accuracy of prediction around 97.6% with a convergence speed.

articleTitle: Observation-based Postural Assessment of Waste Sorting Tasks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Waste Sorting is one of the essential activities to maintain cleanliness within the surroundings. In this paper, a case of waste sorting task has been observed in an Institute dumping yard, and a work cycle is identified. Six work elements are identified in the work cycle, and a detailed postural assessment is done using Rapid Upper Limb Assessment (RULA) and Rapid Entire Body Assessment (REBA) for these work elements to identify the critical task. Further, a Postural Ergonomic Risk Analysis (PERA) is carried out for these work elements to check the suitability of the postures in all the work elements.

articleTitle: Sum Rate Analysis under LoS and NLoS Conditions for a Distributed Indoor Massive MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Massive MIMO an upcoming technology that deals with hundreds to thousands of antennas at the base station supports devices to a greater extent. In massive MIMO system, degrees of freedom tends to be very high that provides high reliability between transmit and receive antennas. For a reliable transmission, a favorable propagation condition is rather needed to be identified. Based on the distance based signal power (DBSP-SR) the uplink channels at the base stations are estimated for sum rate analysis under direct line of sight and Non line of sight conditions. Simulation results shows the performance analysis of sum rate at line of sight are considered to be high and sum rate analysis at Non line of sight conditions are considered to be low.

articleTitle: Learning and Development Center Training Calendar Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Automation takes place everywhere in day-to-day life and automation makes the life simpler and reduce the workload. To reduce the manual work done in NLC, a mobile application is used. That will solve the difficulties in the training scheduling and training registration. A web application and mobile application are developed to reduce the manual work. Web application is used by the admin to schedule the training and the mobile application is used by the employee to make the training registration.

articleTitle: Multi Depot Vehicle Routing Problem using ODV EV Based Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Algorithm (GA) is one among the pioneering bio-inspired optimization algorithm for deriving the solutions to NP hard problems. This algorithm gives the utmost efficiency in finding the best solution even though possesses a minute probability of error. It may locate the nearest optimal solutions with a minimal computation time. The enhanced ODV based GA has been proposed to solve MDVRP. It is evident from the ODV based GA improves the fitness of the solution at the time of population initialization itself. In the proposed model, the customers are first clustered based on distance to their nearest depots, which converts the complicated Multi-Depot VRP to Single Depot VRP and then enhanced ODV based GA is applied to every cluster. Now the routes can be scheduled and optimized using enhanced ODV based GA. The experiments are performed with different types of Cordeaux's Instances from the University of Malaga, Spain.

articleTitle: Framework for Multiple User Acceptance Testing to Avoid Chaos
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Test quality is an essential for accomplishing creation framework superiority. The idea of value is in various dimensions, the vast majority of the exertion in trying setting has been tested near estimating test adequacy. In the testing of the software for every project, user acceptance testing (UAT) is a era of program design progression in which the invention is tried in ”this present reality” by the goal cluster. In SDLC life cycle this UAT should be done statistically. Normally there are 3 main testing levels in UAT which are Unit testing, Integration testing and System testing. While we test the software at every level of testing the overall cost is reduced for the testing in addition to the agile model practices.

articleTitle: A Survey on Theft Surveillance and Detection Technologies
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Nowadays, theft has become a major issue to be dealt with. It is not possible for a human to monitor for several hours continuously. To overcome the complication in thefts, surveillance cameras are used. The main ability of surveillance camera is to just record the act of theft from which only the knowledge of the intruders will be gained. The information about the theft will be received only after the theft had occurred. It fails to detect the intruders and stop the crime earlier. In order to overcome this, a surveillance monitoring system which will be capable of monitoring and detecting these sorts of crime acts are implemented. In this article, the various technologies and the components used in surveillance monitoring system, their pros and cons are discussed. The various features to be considered while evaluating a surveillance system are explored. The overall analysis of the efficiency of currently existing systems is also briefed.

articleTitle: A Study on IoT based Smart Street Light Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Today's modern world people preferred to live the sophisticated life with all facilities. The science and technological developments are growing rapidly to meet the above requirements. With advanced innovations, Internet of Things (IoT) plays a major role to automate different areas like health monitoring, traffic management, agricultural irrigation, street lights, class rooms, etc., Currently we use manual system to operate the street lights, this leads to the enormous energy waste in all over the world and it should be changed. In this survey we studied about, how IoT is used to develop the street lights in the smart way for our modern era. It is an important fact to solve the energy crises and also to develop the street lights to the entire world. In addition, with the study on smart street lighting systems we analyzed and described different sensors and components which are used inIoT environment. All the components of this survey are frequently used and very modest but effective to make the unswerving intelligence systems.

articleTitle: Detection of Lung Cancer using SVM Classifier and KNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In this computer era we are totally going with the automation of everything, in the same way the medical industry is also automated with the help of image processing and data analytics. The best way to control the death cause by cancer is early detection. The medical image or a CT scan image is pre-processed. The contrast of the image is increased with the CLAHE Equalization technique. Then it is segmented with the help of random walk segmentation method. In segmentation the three process will happen the ROI of image is segmented and then then the border correction is done. As third part the continuous pixel change is segmented. The classification is the major portion where the cancerous and non-cancerous is identified with the pre trained model. All the methods used above deals with the traditional way of image processing and data analytics. In Future this accuracy will be boosted with the modern XGboost algorithm where less data is used to get high accuracy.

articleTitle: Automated Attendance Systems Using Face Recognition by K-Means Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Attendance plays a crucial role in educational institutions, several of the other industries and workplaces. Nowadays it's taken by standard methodology i.e. Attendance are taken manually. This method takes a great deal of your time and additionally there might be an error. Face recognition system could be a technology capable of distinguishing or confirming someone from a digital image or from a video supply. In this paper, we tend to build a system that marks the presence of students or employees by recognizing their faces and manufacturing the attending sheet automatically. Face Recognition's accuracy rate is definitely littered with the factors like changes in illumination, posture changes, expression changes, and occlusion. In this paper, a K-means clustering algorithmic rule is employed to research the facial expression. The biometric features of the face unit are extracted and also the K-mean clustering technique is used to cluster the face features. Then, SVM methodology is employed to classify the features of the image. It may accomplish high recognition performance with fewer feature numbers. Finally, a report (attendance sheet) is generated for interpretation.

articleTitle: Review of Blockchain Enabled Decentralized Energy Trading Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: With special emphasis being put upon renewable sources of energy day-by-day, there is a growing demand for this new technology to be integrated into the existing framework. To be widely accepted and made sustainable, such a technology should be profitable for all participating entities; giving them incentive enough to continue using it. What remains to be answered is the question of how that will be done. We break down the traditional power grid into smaller clusters, called microgrid and discuss its properties as potential candidates for implementing Blockchain powered energy trading mechanisms. Blockchain enabled technology is chosen as it brings with it, a degree of security, transparency and automation; and cuts out the established monopoly with the decentralized network and peer-to-peer trading. Two such working algorithms are reviewed for their implementation into the microgrid. One algorithm works on an auction model while another is a calculative data-dependent model but both the models function using smart contracts. Pre-existing projects in this field and their implementation around the world are reviewed by us in the later section of the paper. We conclude this paper by encapsulating the deployment considerations and limitations of employing Blockchain technology in a microgrid.

articleTitle: Coronary Heart Disease Predictive Decision Scheme Using Big Data and RNN
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In todays world, many populations are affected by the Heart disease which is majorly caused as a result of poor diet and life routine of the people. Most of these are mainly caused due to the improper forecasting done by the doctors and the individual people with their own body. This forecasting can be made accurate by implementing recurrent neural networks (RNN), which can be used to make predictive decisions based upon the past medical records of a particular patient. Prediction of the Heart Disease will help to reduce diagnosis time and improve diagnostic accuracy.

articleTitle: An Agent based Resource Provision for IoT through Machine Learning in Fog Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Internet of things (IoT) is a large scale distributed system that is growing at rapid fire pace. It is a technological revolution that makes devices smarter, computations intelligent and communications more informative. While IoT still presuming different definitions, its application had set a broader footprint in almost all walks of our daily life. The voluminous amount of data generated by the millions of IoT devices imposes a higher demand on the computation and storage resources. The compute resources to serve the IoT applications need to be chosen depending upon the heterogeneity of the IoT devices. The various constraints of IoT make resource provisioning in the cloud a non trivial task. Fog computing is the apt platform to deal with such constraints of IoT. The IoT challenges like heterogeneity, scalability and low latency can be addressed by fog computing by adapting intelligence features of machine learning in its resource management techniques. In this paper, we propose a resource management technique for fog computing in which an agent adapts centralized learning and distributed scheduling of IoT tasks. This paper considers the micro data center as the resource that have the hardware and software capability to use TCP/IP protocol suite in fog computing paradigm.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation Based on Hybrid Water Filling Algorithm for Energy Efficiency Enhancement in Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In order to elevate the utility of licensed spectrum bands credit to coexistence within the same network of licensed or primary users and cognitive or secondary users, it is intended to have cognitive radio $(CR)theo/y$. Effective resource allocation between secondary and primary users is the most significant key aspect in this environment. In Cognitive Radio Networks (CRNs), resource allocation is used for total utilization of frequency spectrum Limitations such as transmission power, interference threshold of primary users and traffic demands of secondary users builds the challenge for maximizing the energy-efficiency. In order to overcome the problem of maximum energy consumption and minimum energy efficiency, a Hybrid Water Filling (HWF) Algorithm is proposed. Combination of Multi-Objective Particle Swarm optimization (MOPSO) and Iterative Water Filling (IWF) algorithm is baptized as HWF. MOPSO is used to optimize the sub channels and energy allocation to achieve the highest capacity under the total energy constraint. Thus by combining IWF with MOPSO, the energy efficiency is augmented and provides optimal energy transmission for resource allocation. The simulation results illustrate that the proposed algorithm could achieve the optimal energy allocation than the existing one in less amount of time.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Anthropometric Measures and its significance on Diverse Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper provides a brief survey about the anthropometric traits in various fields. The word “anthropo” refers to human and “metric” refers to measurement. Anthropometry is essentially refers to the measurement of human individuals for the purpose of identifying the human physical variations. Anthropometry plays a predominant role in medical science, Forensic medicine and criminology, Biometric, sports etc. Anthropometric is used to access the size, shape and composition of human body. The purpose of anthropometric indicator criteria to select features and they have been justified mainly on the basis of being correlated with other risk factors. Due to its significance, the statistical mean and standard deviation measurements are highly followed to monitor the human body based on its measurement. Since this measurement vary according to the fields, it is indeed important to undergo a detailed analysis of anthropometric traits. Hence, this paper discusses about the potential researches on the use of anthropometric traits for different fields in association with the data mining to solve the complex problem by selecting the best features.

articleTitle: A Progressive Intrusion Detection System through Event Processing: Challenges and Motivation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In this contemporary world, working on internet is a crucial task owing to the security threats in the network like intrusions, injections etc. To recognize and reduce these system attacks, analysts and academicians have introduced Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs) with the various standards and applications. There are different types of Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) arise to solve the attacks in various environments. Though IDS is more powerful, it produces the results on the abnormal behaviours said to be attacks with false positive and false negative rates which leads to inaccurate detection rate. The other problem is that, there are more number of attacks arising simultaneously with different behaviour being detected by the IDS with high false positive rates which spoils the strength and lifetime of the system, system's efficiency and fault tolerance. Complex Event Processing (CEP) plays a vital role in handling the alerts as events in real time environment which mainly helps to recognize and reduce the redundant alerts.CEP identifies and analyses relationships between events in real time, allowing the system to proactively take efficient actions to respond to specific alerts.In this study, the tendency of Complex Event Processing (CEP) over Intrusion Detection System (IDS) which offers effective handling of the alerts received from IDS in real time and the promotion of the better detection of the attacks are discussed. The merits and challenges of CEP over IDS described in this paper helps to understand and educate the IDS systems to focus on how to tackle the dynamic attacks and its alerts in real time.

articleTitle: Security Analytics For Heterogeneous Web
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In recent days, Enterprises are expanding their business efficiently through web applications which has paved the way for building good consumer relationship with its customers. The major threat faced by these enterprises is their inability to provide secure environments as the web applications are prone to severe vulnerabilities. As a result of this, many security standards and tools have been evolving to handle the vulnerabilities. Though there are many vulnerability detection tools available in the present, they do not provide sufficient information on the attack. For the long-term functioning of an organization, data along with efficient analytics on the vulnerabilities is required to enhance its reliability. The proposed model thus aims to make use of Machine Learning with Analytics to solve the problem in hand. Hence, the sequence of the attack is detected through the pattern using PAA and further the detected vulnerabilities are classified using Machine Learning technique such as SVM. Probabilistic results are provided in order to obtain numerical data sets which could be used for obtaining a report on user and application behavior. Dynamic and Reconfigurable PAA with SVM Classifier is a challenging task to analyze the vulnerabilities and impact of these vulnerabilities in heterogeneous web environment. This will enhance the former processing by analysis of the origin and the pattern of the attack in a more effective manner. Hence, the proposed system is designed to perform detection of attacks. The system works on the mitigation and prevention as part of the attack prediction.

articleTitle: Lisa-life saver
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Recent trends in information system shows that sharing of data among various heterogeneous system needs a proper web oriented service. Exchanging of data is mandatory in various web application systems such as Accident Detection and Ambulance Rescue System, Online transaction security system, Ticket booking system, Car detection and notification system. Passing of information is not done efficiently due to certain issues such as network failure, human errors like pronunciation, inadequate address representations, misunderstanding of the exact location. To deliver an effective web application services there exists GPS tracking facility to identify the exact location, twilio service to pass the information. API helps in fetching and accessing the data even from the operating systems. These features help any common web application to overcome the problem of connectivity and continuity. LISA is a web application system which helps in passing the accidental spot and information to nearby ambulance, police station and to the casualty peer group members. Casualty blood group donors are also spotted. To make it a successful one the above mentioned GPS tracking facility is used to overcome the common problem of manual intervention while identifying and reporting the location in emergency situations. LISA also incorporates the twilio service for faster communication. API's were adopted for better integration and data accessibility. These features helps in overcoming the problem of the rules and regulations in the hospital and FIR formalities for an accidental case by passing info to the casualty peer groups. Casualty nearby blood group donors are also identified and informed via. SMS, voice call. This helps in immediate treatment of the casualty.

articleTitle: Design of Powered Wheelchair for a Differently Abled Person
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: We know that the needs of many people with disabilities can be overcome with power wheelchair, but some portion of this community is finding it difficult to operate power wheelchair. Though we have evolved in the field of health care and technology, but we are still not good enough to solve difficulties of this sector of population. This project is related to an arduino controlled wheel chair along with an alternative use of manual joystick. The main objective of this project is to felicitate and increase the movement of people who are handicapped and the ones who are not able to move freely. Therefore, we are coming up with a design of wheelchair which will be an asset for medical department and to make it more advanced in existing technology and allows the victim to live a free life.

articleTitle: Bio-inspired Underwater Undulatory Motion by using Polypyrrole Bimorph Actuator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In this paper, development of PPy actuator based undulatory underwater robotic motion is presented. For generation of undulatory motion, the PPy actuator has been implemented as the body or tail in a tadpole like robot. The PPy actuator is fixed inside the head region of the tadpole like robot prototype and set to behave like a cantilever. On supplying AC voltage, the PPy actuator experiences transverse bending similar to lateral body undulation in natural tadpole. The motion of the prototype is modeled by using Lighthils elongated body theory along with electro-visco-mechanical actuation of PPy actuator operates in underwater medium. Following this, the real time swimming experiment has been carried out in a still water tank. It has been found that, the PPy actuator based tail exhibit undulatory motion with significant high displacement and thrust on applying 1. 3Volt and 1Hz frequency. The tail beat frequency and speed of the robot is near to natural tadpole, hence the proposed work may use for various underwater applications like surveillance, environmental monitoring and pollution detection.

articleTitle: Survey on Prediction of Smartphone Virality Using Twitter Analytics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Smartphone companies have been using social media as one of the main platforms to market and promote their products. Most companies use platforms like Twitter as these are very popular. Also in-depth analysis of the tweets and its metrics can give an insight into the success of the particular product. Taking the above points into consideration, we propose a system which can be used to (i) predict virality of the tweets relating to the product and (ii) perform sentiment analysis of the tweets in question in order to derive the sentiment regarding the product. Hence, the proposed system tries to predict the exact probability of the success of the tweet and the product. The algorithm to be used is a customized Naive Bayes algorithm which takes into consideration the dependence between the various parameters involved and by making use of weights for each of the variables. This algorithm can be used by the companies to improve their marketing and other strategies to promote their product.

articleTitle: A study of Prediction models for football player valuations by quantifying statistical and economic attributes for the global transfer market
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The global transfer market in the field of football has long been devoid of technology. Over the last two decades, the economic dynamics have completely been changed, and the amount of money which has been pumped has increased exponentially. Valuations for any physical entity with a well-defined set of parameters is a challenge in itself and depends on numerous other things. And doing the same for an individual with varying parameters, based on the source of data, is even more challenging. With this paper, we attempt to find the most optimum way of fetching data of football players and applying the right model on it so as to extract meaningful information, thus reducing the gap between the estimated prices and the Final price. We do so by crowdsourcing the data and applying regression techniques along with Opta index. We also try to find the results using Neural Networks and conclude with a comparison between our models.

articleTitle: Design and Fabrication of Fluidized Bed Incinerator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Now a day's burning of medical waste and municipal waste are becoming very harmful and made the environment pollutant and toxic. These wastes are not fully burnt. For avoiding this pollution, we are going to burn this medical waste and municipal waste in a closed chamber called fluidized bed incinerator were this wastes are fully burnt and free from toxic pollution. Due to burning these wastes in the closed chamber, more amount of heat dissipated around the incinerator and this heat dissipated is not used properly. In our project we are going to use the heat dissipated by the incinerator. We are going to minimize the inorganic bio-medical waste that is produced in the hospitals and other wastes that are produced after combustion are reused in usable ways. So that environmental pollution produced by the hospital waste such as Deep Well Injection, Pyrolysis etc, affects agricultural lands, ground water and cause global warming that affects the complete biosphere. That can be controlled in our project in a very good manner. In our project the flue gases that come out after combustion are filtered by various methods of filtration. The heat dissipated from the incinerator is cooled by the water that can be used as hot water that can be used in the hospital for various purposes such as sterilizing the syringe, cleaning the utensils, medical equipment's etc.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: IMC Controller for a class of Higher Order Overdamped Systems Approximated as Lower Order Integer and Non-Integer Models using Genetic Algorithm

In this paper, an attempt has been made to design Internal Model Control (IMC), for a class of overdamped higher order systems using Genetic Algorithm. The IMC scheme is more simple in its tuning and implementation as compared to classical feedback control structure. To deal with the complexities of higher order systems, they are reduced to First Order Plus Delay models using some well-established model order reduction technique. Since IMC control performance depends on the accuracy of plants being modelled, therefore an effort has been made in the present work to minimize the modeling error while model order reduction by introducing the concept of non-integer order systems. To show the greatness of IMC performance, incorporating the reduced non-integer model over integer order model, a comparative study has been made.
